//: What: Package manifest for @sapdx/findings, the shared finding model, SARIF conversion and baseline gate.
Why: Every tool depends on this one contract so findings from all tools can be merged, compared and gated together.
If missing or unlinked: All @sapdx tools fail to import @sapdx/findings; nothing can report or gate findings.
name: @sapdx/findings
description: Common finding model, severity scale, SARIF 2.1.0 conversion and baseline gate shared by all accelerators.
